rules.name: no-new-comments
rules.fix: Delete the comment. If it explains a workaround, fix what it works around; if it states a constraint, turn the constraint into a type, a test or a check.

rules.name: no-new-effects
rules.fix: Compute the value while rendering, or move the work to where the data is loaded. Effects belong in shared hooks, not in product components.

rules.name: no-new-timers
rules.fix: A timer in a component hides an ordering problem. Find what the code is waiting for and wait for that.

rules.name: no-new-suppressions
rules.fix: Fix what the checker reports instead of silencing it.

rules.name: no-optional-clock
rules.fix: Make it a required parameter and pass the real one where the program starts. An optional clock is the real clock for every caller that forgets it.

rules.name: no-reading-error-text
rules.fix: Give the error a code or a type where it is raised, and branch on that. Matching on wording breaks the day the message improves.

rules.name: no-skipped-tests
rules.fix: Make the test pass or delete it. A skipped test proves nothing.

rules.name: no-module-mocks
rules.fix: Pass the code a fake through a parameter, the way production passes it the real thing. If the code cannot take one, change it so it can.

rules.name: no-spies
rules.fix: Assert what comes back through the interface: a result, a state, a row you can read back. Which calls were made is not something a caller can see.

rules.name: no-fake-timers
rules.fix: Pass the code a clock the test controls, and move that clock yourself. Patching a global changes it for every other test too.

rules.name: no-wall-clock-in-tests
rules.fix: Start the test's clock at a fixed instant and state every time relative to it. A test that reads the real clock passes until a date goes by.

rules.name: no-sleeps-in-tests
rules.fix: Wait for the thing itself, or advance a clock the test controls. A sleep is slow and still races.

rules.name: no-casts-in-tests
rules.fix: Build the value with a factory so it type-checks. A cast hides the mistake the test is there to catch.

rules.name: no-sql-in-tests
rules.fix: Build and read state through a factory or the code's own interface. If neither can express it, extend the factory.

rules.name: no-hand-set-role
rules.fix: Make the request as that user, so the app's own role switch runs. A test that sets the role itself proves only its own copy of the switch.
